 Pricing Course finder 
 How our teacher pathway works
 Students at A2 level and below (teens and adults) first study with our local, Russian-speaking teachers for about 3–4 months. They explain grammar clearly in your own language and build a solid base. After that, students move on to lessons with a native speaker.
 Young learners follow the same logic: Starters and Movers are taught by local teachers only. Flyers, KET and PET can be taught by local teachers or by native speakers.

## teachers
01 — Staff
 The people behind the standard
 A small, qualified team — native-speaking and local instructors, each specialised by age group and level.
 Abdoulie Manneh
 Founder & Director, IF Academy
 Abdoulie Manneh is the founder of IF Academy and its native English-speaking teacher. Originally from The Gambia, he has taught for over 14 years in Africa, Russia and Kazakhstan, including corporate programmes for companies such as Lukoil and Rosatom. He holds degrees from universities in The Gambia, Taiwan and Russia, is TESOL-certified, and is completing a Doctor of Business Administration at Maqsut Narikbayev University.
 Teaching philosophy:
 Abdoulie believes a language is learned by using it. His lessons are built on real conversation, debate and games in small, personal classes. Having learned Russian and Arabic himself, he aims to make every lesson challenging and confidence-building. Each student should leave able to say something they couldn't say before.
 Aitach Nabiyeva
 Local Teacher
 I am a passionate English educator committed to making language learning engaging, inspiring, and meaningful. Through a personalised approach and supportive atmosphere, I help students build confidence, develop fluency, and unlock new opportunities through English.
 Alina Afanasyeva
 English Teacher
 Alina holds a Bachelor's degree in Linguistics and teaches English to children, teenagers and adults.
 Teaching philosophy:
 Alina's lessons are engaging, supportive and personalised to each student. Her aim is for every learner to feel confident, speak more freely and genuinely enjoy learning English.
 Olya Harutyunyan
 English Teacher
 I am a Foreign Philology Bachelor’s student with a passion for the English language and teaching. My teaching philosophy is to create a supportive, engaging environment where students feel comfortable learning, making mistakes, and expressing themselves. I believe that learning English should be practical, enjoyable, and tailored to each student’s needs.

I enjoy working with people, staying organised, and creating a positive and welcoming learning environment!

## ecosystem
05 — Ecosystem
 Three spaces, one standard
 Beyond the classroom, Intellect First runs a small ecosystem of spaces built for practice, immersion and production.
 IF Hub
 Speaking clubs, debates, public speaking practice and current-affairs discussion — where fluency meets confidence.
 IF Lab
 Intensive small-group work, IELTS-focused sessions and workshops for professional development.
 IF Studio
 Individual and online lessons, video production and podcasts — content that extends learning beyond the room.

## faqs
07 — FAQs
 Questions, answered
 How do I get started? Book a free placement test through Telegram or email — we'll assess your level and recommend the right class.
 What levels do you teach? Beginner (A1) through Upper-Intermediate (C1) for General English, plus Cambridge exam tracks (Starters, Movers, Flyers, KET, PET) for young learners.
 Are classes online or in person? Both — General English for the Russian market runs online; classes in Kazakhstan run in person across our three spaces (IF Business Lab, IF Hub, IF Studio).
 Do you offer corporate or group training? Yes — Corporate Training is quote-based and customised to your organisation, available online and offline.
 Need to change a class time or teacher? Contact the academy directly and we'll arrange it.

## about
08 — About
 Built on one conviction
 Intellect First was founded on the conviction that language instruction should be judged the way any serious education is judged — by rigour, by outcomes, and by the calibre of the people delivering it.
 Every class is led by qualified instructors, held to international standards, and built around small groups so that no student goes unheard. The result is an academy that operates less like a language centre and more like a proper school of thought.
 Excellence
 Held as the operating standard, not a marketing word
 Small groups
 3–6 students in General English, so instruction stays personal
 Global perspective
 Curriculum benchmarked against international standards
 Native instruction
 Available through the Premium English track
